reproducibility: The own-text-only arm is NOT a reproducible measurement. Stripping the inherited chain leaves 6,370 provisions whose own text is "Other", so index-levels-own-text holds 18,372 of 29,861 rows in byte-identical vector groups. Those tie exactly against every query, and np.argpartition chooses which k of 6,370 equal rows enter the pool arbitrarily - which kind="stable" in VectorIndex.search does not fix. Re-running this report would not make the own-text-only figures stable. The direction of the finding is unaffected: a 7.5-point fall in top1@6 is far outside any tie-break swing, and ties this degenerate are themselves the mechanism the inherited chain prevents.
